about: Direct build path mutants (internal/sketch/build/direct.go, direct_plan.go): each drops one input from an action key or the plan fingerprint. TestDirectRebuildsOnEachInput edits that input and counts the actions that must run again, and checks the executable against go build's; it builds Go (full tier). The embed-* mutants (embed.go) each break one of Go's //go:embed rules or the embed key: TestDirectEmbedMatchesGoBuild generates trees that reach each rule and checks that the direct path builds go build's executable or refuses where go build fails; TestDirectEmbedRebuilds counts compiles after each edit of an embedded file. The cache-bound-* mutants are the emission cache's bounds (wf10 CACHE-bound): the root that ERGO_CACHE names, and the entry cap with its least-recently-used pass, which never removes an entry a build holds.

mutants.name: direct-key-content
mutants.rule: A compile key holds every source file's content.

mutants.name: direct-key-file-name
mutants.rule: A compile key holds every source file's name: positions in the object and its export data name it.

mutants.name: direct-key-trimmed-path
mutants.rule: A compile key holds the package's trimmed directory (module path@version/rel), which -trimpath writes into every position.

mutants.name: direct-key-export
mutants.rule: A compile key holds the export data digest of every import.

mutants.name: direct-key-lang
mutants.rule: A compile key holds -lang, the go line of the package's module.

mutants.name: direct-key-tool
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the content digest of the tool that runs it.

mutants.name: direct-key-goos
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the target operating system.

mutants.name: direct-key-level
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the architecture level as VARIABLE=value (GOAMD64, GOARM64); the variable names the architecture, so the key holds no separate GOARCH.

mutants.name: direct-link-modinfo
mutants.rule: The link key holds the build information the executable carries.

mutants.name: direct-link-extld
mutants.rule: The link key holds -extld, as cmd/go's link action ID holds the C compiler.

mutants.name: direct-link-archive
mutants.rule: The link key holds the archive digest of every linked package, not only its export data: a body edit with the same export data relinks.

mutants.name: direct-export-whole-archive
mutants.rule: An importer's compile key reads the export data only, so a body edit that keeps it does not recompile the importers.

mutants.name: direct-plan-env
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds the go variables of the environment: another GOARCH or CC makes another plan.

mutants.name: direct-plan-std
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds the standard imports: a new one makes a plan that has its archive.

mutants.name: direct-gobuild-ignored
mutants.rule: Toolchain.GoBuild selects go build, the reference path; the identity property compares against it, so it must not take the direct path.

mutants.name: direct-plan-gomod
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds every go.mod: the go line chooses the toolchain. The rows that edit a go.mod count the plan made again; a wrong executable needs a second toolchain on the host.

mutants.name: direct-plan-tags
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds the build tags: they select the standard packages' files (netgo). The build tags row counts the plan made again.

mutants.name: bs4-strip-ignored
mutants.rule: binsize plan 3 (e): a stripped build is another Go build action over the same emitted module (the flag is the action's, not the emission key's).

mutants.name: direct-strip-ignored
mutants.rule: The direct link honors Toolchain.Strip as go build -ldflags='-s -w' does: the stripped executable equals go build's.

mutants.name: direct-key-strip
mutants.rule: The link key holds Strip: a stripped build after an unstripped one links again.

mutants.name: embed-hidden
mutants.rule: A directory walk skips names that begin with . or _ unless the pattern says all:.

mutants.name: embed-walk-module
mutants.rule: A directory walk does not enter another module.

mutants.name: embed-match-module
mutants.rule: A matched file in another module is an error.

mutants.name: embed-non-directory
mutants.rule: A match under a symbolic link to a directory is an error.

mutants.name: embed-bad-match-name
mutants.rule: A matched file or a directory above it with an invalid name is an error.

mutants.name: embed-bad-walk-file
mutants.from: return fmt.Errorf("cannot embed file %s: invalid name", rel)
mutants.rule: A walk that meets a visible file with an invalid name is an error.

mutants.name: embed-vcs
mutants.rule: Version control directories are never embedded, even under all:.

mutants.name: embed-trailing-dot
mutants.rule: A name that ends in a dot is invalid.

mutants.name: embed-name-chars
mutants.rule: An ASCII character outside module.CheckFilePath's set makes a name invalid.

mutants.name: embed-non-ascii
mutants.rule: A non-ASCII name is left to go build (Unicode tables), not called invalid.

mutants.name: embed-reserved
mutants.rule: A Windows reserved name before the first dot, in any case, is invalid.

mutants.name: embed-no-match
mutants.rule: A pattern that matches no file is an error.

mutants.name: embed-empty-dir
mutants.rule: A matched directory with nothing to embed is an error.

mutants.name: embed-irregular
mutants.from: return nil, fmt.Errorf("pattern %s: cannot embed irregular file %s", pattern, rel)
mutants.rule: A matched irregular file (a symbolic link) is an error, or under GODEBUG embedfollowsymlinks=1 go build's to decide.

mutants.name: embed-walk-irregular
mutants.rule: A walk skips irregular files (symbolic links).

mutants.name: embed-pattern-syntax
mutants.rule: A pattern that is not a valid io/fs path is an error.

mutants.name: embed-quote-glob
mutants.rule: Glob characters in the package directory match only themselves.

mutants.name: embed-key-content
mutants.rule: A compile key holds each embedded file's content.

mutants.name: embed-key-name
mutants.rule: A compile key holds each embedded file's name (a rename with the same content rebuilds).

mutants.name: embed-cfg
mutants.rule: A compile of an embedding package passes the embed configuration.

mutants.name: tc-managed-root-unset
mutants.rule: A managed toolchain's action runs with its own GOROOT and GOTOOLCHAIN=local, whatever the user set.

mutants.name: cache-bound-root-variable-ignored
mutants.to: if dir := getenv(RootVariable); false && own && dir != "" {
mutants.rule: An absolute ERGO_CACHE names the emission cache root before XDG_CACHE_HOME and the user's cache directory; the tests' private cache rests on it.

mutants.name: cache-bound-cap-not-counted
mutants.rule: A build that published an entry past the cap runs the cap pass, due or not, so publication cannot grow the cache past entryCap.

mutants.name: cache-bound-cap-evicts-newest
mutants.rule: The cap pass removes the least recently used entries first.

mutants.name: cache-bound-cap-removes-all
mutants.rule: The cap pass removes no more than the entries past the cap: the entryCap most recently used stay.

mutants.name: cache-bound-cap-ignores-holds
mutants.from: if c.takeAside(e.path, func(mark time.Time) bool { return !mark.After(e.mark) }) {
mutants.rule: The cap pass removes an entry only under its exclusive lock, so never one a build holds, in this process or another.

mutants.name: cache-bound-cap-stale-recheck
mutants.rule: The cap pass passes over an entry a build marked used after the pass read its mark: it is now the most recently used, and the next oldest goes instead.

mutants.name: cache-bound-cap-bounded-per-pass
mutants.rule: A cache far past the cap is within it after one cap pass; the pass removes the whole excess.

mutants.name: cache-bound-forgotten-not-refused
mutants.to: if test, ok := testRoots(root); false && ok {
mutants.rule: Under a Go test, DefaultRoot refuses the user's cache, whatever environment the test gave the process.

mutants.name: cache-bound-ancestry-unread
mutants.rule: The rule finds the test through the process's ancestry, so a program a test starts is refused too.

mutants.name: cache-bound-environ-unread
mutants.rule: The user's cache is the one the test's starting environment names (/proc/PID/environ).

mutants.name: cache-bound-ancestor-own-counted
mutants.rule: The test's ERGO_CACHE does not hide the user's cache: the rule resolves the test's starting environment without it.

mutants.name: cache-bound-test-name-unread
mutants.rule: A Go test binary run with no flags is known by its .test name.

mutants.name: cache-bound-test-flag-unread
mutants.rule: A Go test binary of another name is known by its testing flags.
